_comment: Copy to config.local.json and fill in. config.local.json is gitignored and must NEVER be committed — this repository is public. Do not put real children's names here; the display name shown on a profile tile can be a nickname.

network._comment: Leave empty. Wi-Fi is configured on the device through the launcher, not from a file in a public repo.

parent._comment: Set on first boot through the launcher. Stored hashed on the device. Never put a real PIN here.

development._comment: All false for anything that leaves the bench. See docs/threat-model.md.
